body: A point also worth noting, is if/when Kabocha becomes a KSM parachain, we will have access to DEXs, then we can bridge EDG and KAB and hey presto, everyone is happy :)

I think we should consider integrating with [Zenlink](https://zenlink.pro/en/). They're live on Moonriver and Bifrost, have created a Substrate native DEX as pallet and as contract, both WASM and EVM.
They're focused on connecting parachains though and not stand-alone chains, but obviously made a very versatile tech-stack [-> Github](https://github.com/zenlinkpro) 

Darwinia will have a Substrate to Substrate bridge out very soon, working without any pooled or locked assets.

I'm also working on integrating EDG into the DCRDEX again, something I believe we need as part of our long term security / exchange. 

Are there any solo chain DEX's launching in Substrate ecosystem?
